title: Repository onboarding path
alt: Six commands scaffold config, pin the lock, compile context, record debt, prepare a devcontainer, and verify governance.
text: Onboarding commands, in order: 1. Scaffolding (praetorctl init), 2. Lockfile Pinning (praetorctl profile set --lock-source-root), 3. Context Recompilation (praetorctl compile-context), 4. Brownfield Baselining (praetorctl baseline --record --allow-increase), 5. Devcontainer Setup (praetorctl devcontainer generate --source-root), 6. Audit Verification (praetorctl audit --offline).
Boxes: Target repository (already carries AGENTS.md), Quickstart (praetorctl adopt), Audit passes (the quickstart), Remaining gaps (does not pass audit on its own).
Target repository → 1. Scaffolding (start) → 2. Lockfile Pinning → 3. Context Recompilation → 4. Brownfield Baselining → 5. Devcontainer Setup → 6. Audit Verification.
Quickstart → 6. Audit Verification (skips 1-5) → Audit passes (audit passes).

Scenario 1, init: Write the configuration, then compile the vendor files from AGENTS.md. init reads AGENTS.md beside the manifest; without it, init writes no agent files. createInitialManifest and initBaselineAndLockfile write the manifest, an unpinned placeholder lockfile and a zero-debt baseline. initAgentContext runs the compile-context write: Git ignores .workingdir/evidence/, the text register is spliced into AGENTS.md, and the six vendor files and persona copies are compiled and linted.

Scenario 2, profile set: Pin the lockfile and write the policy catalog from the Praetor checkout. profile set pins placeholder lockfile digests from the reviewed Praetor source root. devcontainer generate and audit require sha256 digests; pinning also materializes the catalog under .config/archetypes/.

Scenario 3, compile-context: Recompile the vendor files and persona copies; rerun after every AGENTS.md edit. compile-context runs the same write that init ran. writeAgentSurfaces copies every .agents/agents persona into each client persona directory, then the caveman lint runs.

Scenario 4, baseline: Snapshot legacy technical debt into baseline file. HISS scanner sweeps the codebase for existing infractions. Initial legacy debt is recorded with --allow-increase and --reason="<why>" to permit non-zero count.
(Shortened to 2500 characters; docs/figures/onboarding-path.ts holds the full content.)
